lines: No account needed — you'll get a personal link that is your access to this session.
You appear in this session's list right away; the club head seats you as a speaker or the adjudicator.

blocks.text: The ONLY registration URL. A guest is an engine participant with NO engine account; the personal link keeps its participant id and the engine's one-time claim token. Once registration closes: "Registration is closed for this session. Ask the club head about the next session."
